newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-NIGERIA ANNOUNCE WORLD CUP SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIA ANNOUNCE WORLD CUP SQUAD.

text.p: Olympic champions Nigeria have named a squad of 18 foreign-based players for a World Cup qualifier against Kenya in Nairobi on January 11.
Nigeria, who beat Burkina Faso 2-0 in their first group game in November, are second on goal difference behind Guinea, who defeated Kenya 3-1.
Goalkeepers: Oladosu Joseph (Reggiana), Willy Okapara (Orlando Pirates).
Defenders: Mobi Oparaku (Turnhout), Uche Okechukwu (Fenerbahce), Taribo West (Auxerre), Uche Okafor (Kansa City), Celestine Babayaro, Chidi Nwanu (both Anderlecht).
Midfielders: Austin "Jay-Jay" Okocha (Fenerbahce), Garba Lawal (Utrecht), Sunday Oliseh (Cologne), Wilson Oruma (Nancy).
Forwards: Tijani Babangida (Ajax), Victor Ikpeba (Monaco), Jonathan Akpoborie (Hansa Rostock), Daniel Amokachi (Besiktas), Finidi George (Real Betis), Emmanuel Amunike (Barcelona).
